prompt: We're terminating a marketing SaaS vendor that had an OAuth integration into our Salesforce and held customer contact data. Give me the offboarding plan.
assertions: Revokes ALL access including the OAuth grants/API tokens specifically (not just SSO/passwords) — and cites the integration-token risk pattern (e.g., the August 2025 Salesloft Drift breach where stolen OAuth tokens exposed Salesforce data at hundreds of organisations)
Handles data: inventory, return in agreed format, certified deletion including backup-cycle expiry, and sub-processor deletion flow-down
Cleans technical debris: webhooks, connected-app registrations, service accounts, DNS/integrations
Covers contractual closure: termination assistance obligations, records retention, surviving clauses, final settlement
Adds post-exit verification (e.g., ~30-day log review confirming no residual access) and feeds lessons back into the vendor register/tiering
